content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02046 If ComIPduSignalProcessing for an I-PDU is configured to DEFERRED , the AU- TOSAR COM module shall first copy the relevant data (e.g. configured ComSignal ) of the received I-PDU within the Com_RxIndication function or the related TP recep- tion functions respectively from the PduR into COM. Then the AUTOSAR COM module shall invoke the configured <ComUser_CbkRxAck> for the included signals and signal groups asynchronously during the next call to Com_MainFunctionRx .
